// fx.cpp
// Generated by logue-patcher's logue-codegen.
// NOT hand-written -- do not edit directly, re-export instead.
#include "userdelfx.h"

// Effects link no oscillator API -- stand-ins for the two symbols primitives use.
#define osc_sinf fx_sinf
static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) float osc_w0f_for_note(uint8_t note, uint8_t mod)
{
  const float f = 440.f * fastpow2f(((float)note + (float)mod * (1.f / 255.f) - 69.f) * (1.f / 12.f));
  return (f < 23679.643054f ? f : 23679.643054f) * (1.f / 48000.f);
}

class Fx
{
public:
  void init()
  {
    note_ = 60.f;
    noteFine_ = 0.f;
    tempo_ = 120.f;
    time01_ = 0.f;
    depth01_ = 0.f;
    mix01_ = 0.f;
    z1_lp = 0.f;
    cutoff_lp = 100 * 0.01f;
    fadePercent_x = 50;
    mix01_ = 0.5f;
  }

  // Delay lines and state cleared, knob positions kept.
  void reset()
  {
    z1_lp = 0.f;
  }

  void setKnob(uint8_t index, float v)
  {
    switch (index)
    {
    case k_user_delfx_param_time: time01_ = v; break;
    case k_user_delfx_param_depth: depth01_ = v; break;
    case k_user_delfx_param_shift_depth: mix01_ = v; break;
    default: break;
    }
  }

  // Every input sample of a frame is read before its outputs are written: delay and reverb
  // units process in place.
  void process(const float *in, float *out, uint32_t frames)
  {
    const float bpm = fx_get_bpmf();
    if (bpm > 0.f) tempo_ = bpm;
    fadePercent_x = (0.f + mix01_ * 100.f);
    const float blkFadeA_x = xfade_sqrtf(1.f - ((fadePercent_x * 0.01f)));
    const float blkFadeB_x = xfade_sqrtf((fadePercent_x * 0.01f));
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < frames; ++i)
    {
      const float y_in_l = in[2 * i];
      const float y_in_r = in[2 * i + 1];
      const float y_in_mono = 0.5f * (y_in_l + y_in_r);
      float y_lp = onepole_step(&z1_lp, y_in_mono, cutoff_warp(cutoff_lp));
      float y_x = (blkFadeA_x * (y_in_mono) + blkFadeB_x * (y_lp));
      out[2 * i] = clip1m1f(y_x);
      out[2 * i + 1] = clip1m1f(y_x);
    }
  }

private:
  // The note a primitive that follows the played note (an oscillator's pitch, a TRACK filter)
  // reads: an effect gets none, so it's a fixed middle C.
  float note_;
  float noteFine_;
  // The fixed knobs' positions (0..1), as the device reports them.
  float time01_;
  float depth01_;
  float mix01_;
  // The device tempo in BPM, 120 until the device gives one.
  float tempo_;
  float z1_lp;
  float cutoff_lp;
  float fadePercent_x;

  static float onepole_step(float *z1, float x, float a)
  {
    float aClamped = a;
    if (aClamped < 0.f) aClamped = 0.f;
    else if (aClamped > 1.f) aClamped = 1.f;
    float y = *z1 + aClamped * (x - *z1);
    *z1 = y;
    return y;
  }

  static float cutoff_warp(float t)
  {
    if (t < 0.f) t = 0.f;
    else if (t > 1.f) t = 1.f;
    return t * t * t;
  }

  static float clampf(float v, float lo, float hi)
  {
    return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v);
  }

  static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) float xfade_sqrtf(float x)
  {
#if defined(__arm__) && defined(__ARM_FP)
    float r;
    __asm__("vsqrt.f32 %0, %1" : "=t"(r) : "t"(x));
    return r;
#else
    return sqrtf(x);
#endif
  }
};

static Fx s_fx;

void DELFX_INIT(uint32_t platform, uint32_t api)
{
  (void)platform;
  (void)api;
  s_fx.init();
}

void DELFX_PROCESS(float *xn, uint32_t frames) { s_fx.process(xn, xn, frames); }

void DELFX_SUSPEND(void) {}

// Cleared on resume as well, so a unit switched back in never replays a stale line.
void DELFX_RESUME(void) { s_fx.reset(); }

// Q31 (0..2^31-1, 10 bits of it real), not 0..1023 (the phase 0 spike, on a real xd).
void DELFX_PARAM(uint8_t index, int32_t value) { s_fx.setKnob(index, clip01f(q31_to_f32(value))); }

// tpl/_unit.c
#include "userdelfx.h"

extern uint8_t _bss_start;
extern uint8_t _bss_end;

extern void (*__init_array_start []) (void);
extern void (*__init_array_end []) (void);

typedef void (*__init_fptr)(void);

__attribute__((used, section(".hooks")))
static const user_delfx_hook_table_t s_hook_table = {
  .magic = {'U','D','E','L'},
  .api = USER_API_VERSION,
  .platform = USER_TARGET_PLATFORM>>8,
  .reserved0 = {0},
  .func_entry = _entry,
  .func_process = _hook_process,
  .func_suspend = _hook_suspend,
  .func_resume = _hook_resume,
  .func_param = _hook_param,
  .reserved1 = {0}
};

__attribute__((used))
void _entry(uint32_t platform, uint32_t api)
{
  uint8_t * __restrict bss_p = (uint8_t *)&_bss_start;
  const uint8_t * const bss_e = (uint8_t *)&_bss_end;

  for (; bss_p != bss_e;)
    *(bss_p++) = 0;

  const size_t count = __init_array_end - __init_array_start;
  for (size_t i = 0; i<count; ++i) {
    __init_fptr init_p = (__init_fptr)__init_array_start[i];
    if (init_p != NULL)
      init_p();
  }

  _hook_init(platform, api);
}

__attribute__((weak))
void _hook_init(uint32_t platform, uint32_t api)
{
  (void)platform;
  (void)api;
}

__attribute__((weak))
void _hook_process(float *xn, uint32_t frames)
{
  (void)xn;
  (void)frames;
}

__attribute__((weak))
void _hook_suspend(void)
{
}

__attribute__((weak))
void _hook_resume(void)
{
}

__attribute__((weak))
void _hook_param(uint8_t index, int32_t value)
{
  (void)index;
  (void)value;
}
